references.text: This text introduces Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, who rebelled against Moses together with Korah.
Dathan and Abiram refused to come when Moses called for them, and they accused Moses of bringing them out of Egypt.
Moses went to the tents of Dathan and Abiram, and the people were warned to stay away from these rebels.
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and Abiram along with their families, tents, and everything they owned - the primary account referred to in Deuteronomy 11:6.
A later reference to the rebellion of Dathan and Abiram and how the earth opened up and swallowed them.
The psalm reminds us how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, and fire consumed the company of Abiram.
